blockers.missing_general_contract: A source-neutral contract for coupled multi-component electron delivery, metallocluster identity/state, and state-transition provenance.
blockers.unlock_condition: Approve and validate a generic component/state-transition object against at least three unrelated multi-component metallocluster cases before selection freeze.
blockers.why_material: Flattening component and cluster states into mechanism prose would hide applicability and redox uncertainty and would create nitrogenase-specific fields.

blockers.missing_general_contract: A source-neutral contract for coupled subunit conformations, channel state, transported-intermediate identity, and evidence-scoped gating alternatives.
blockers.unlock_condition: Approve and validate a generic coupled-state/channel representation on unrelated gated multi-component enzymes before selection freeze.
blockers.why_material: Treating the channel and allosteric coupling as unstructured notes would lose the defining applicability pressure and invite family-specific fields.

blockers.missing_general_contract: A source-neutral contract for polymer chain state, reaction-instance boundaries, processivity, and repeat-unit provenance.
blockers.unlock_condition: Approve and validate generic polymer/reaction-instance semantics across at least three unrelated polymer-processing enzymes before selection freeze.
blockers.why_material: A single small-molecule reaction object cannot distinguish initiation, elongation, product chain length, and processivity without convenience assumptions.

next_action_boundary: Do not add family-specific fields or compile these cases. A later explicit governing-contract decision is required before any blocked case can enter a selection freeze.
